2) Description

May recommend to Mayor and Council and City Manager such services, administrative and policy procedures for the operation of the Convention Center Department as the Commission may deem proper. 8 year term limit.

3) Maximum Number of Members

7

4) Meeting Location

Tucson Convention Center

5) Meeting Time

January 22, April 16, 2026 and July and October 2026 TBD @ 9:30 a.m.
